headerDisplay: Doimus plugin for TP-Link Tapo/Kasa devices. Supports Kasa/Tapo hubs (KH100/H100) with sensors, Tapo WiFi cameras, and doorbells.
footerDisplay: For hub devices: configure your Tapo/Kasa account email, password, and hub IP addresses. For cameras: configure each camera's IP, Tapo credentials, and RTSP stream credentials.

devices.title: Hub IP Addresses
devices.description: IP addresses of your Kasa/Tapo hubs (KH100/H100)

pollInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll hub devices for state updates

cameras.title: Tapo WiFi Cameras
cameras.description: Configure your Tapo WiFi cameras and doorbells

ipAddress.title: Camera IP Address
ipAddress.description: IP address of the Tapo camera

password.title: Tapo Account Password
password.description: Your Tapo account password (or camera password if different)

streamUser.title: RTSP Username
streamUser.description: RTSP stream username (from Tapo app > Camera Account)

streamPassword.title: RTSP Password
streamPassword.description: RTSP stream password (from Tapo app > Camera Account)

batteryPowered.title: Battery-Powered
batteryPowered.description: Enable if this is a battery-powered camera (C420, C425, D230, etc.). Adds battery level reporting.

disableBatteryReporting.title: Disable Battery Reporting
disableBatteryReporting.description: Skip battery status queries for this camera

pullInterval.title: Pull Interval (ms)
pullInterval.description: Polling interval for camera status updates

snapshotOnMotion.title: Snapshot on Motion
snapshotOnMotion.description: Capture MJPEG snapshots only when ONVIF motion is detected (recommended for battery cameras). When disabled, snapshots are taken on every poll interval.

snapshotCooldown.title: Snapshot Cooldown (ms)
snapshotCooldown.description: Minimum time between motion-triggered snapshots (prevents rapid-fire captures)
